title: Moderate flooding
description: A 1-in-100-year storm tide today (1.6 m AHD) backs up the Yarra while local depressions are full of stormwater. A static estimate, not a hydraulic model: no flow or velocity. Upstream river flows can raise Southbank levels above the bay tide level, so river depths are a lower bound.
sources: Mechanism: Melbourne Water, Southbank Precinct Local Floodplain Development Plan (2026).

River level: Melbourne Water 1% annual exceedance probability tide level in Port Phillip Bay, Planning for Sea Level Rise Guidelines (2017), as cited in GHD (2019) Appendix G, Fishermans Bend flood levee memo. Today: 1.6 m AHD.
Stormwater ponding: closed terrain depressions inside the Special Building Overlay (overland flow) extents, Vicmap Planning (CC BY 4.0).
Ground: Geoscience Australia 5 m LiDAR digital elevation model (CC BY 4.0).
